sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant and the learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

2. This application under Section 528 BNSS has been filed with the prayer to quash to quash the NBW dated 14.3.2013 to 22.8.2025 passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate, Sadabad, Hathras in Case No. 687 of 2010 under Section 7/19 Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, P.S.- Sadabad,
District- Hathras pending in the Court of Judicial Magistrate, Sadabad, Hathras.

District- Hathras
entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text: Court of Judicial Magistrate, Sadabad, Hathras
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Further prayer has been made to stay the effect and operation of the aforesaid order.

3. It is brought to the notice of this Court that the present application has been moved challenging the order issuing non-bailable warrant dated 14.3.2013, however, since 2013 the applicant never bothered to come to the Court at Hathras and he never met his counsel, as submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant of this case.
4.
It is gross negligence on the part of the accused-applicant, hence there is no justification to grant relief which has been prayed by the accused applicant.

However, he is directed to appear before the trial Court at Hathras and apply for bail and the trial Court is directed that if his bail application is moved it shall be heard and decided expeditiously in accordance with law.
5. In view of the aforesaid, the application stands disposed of.
